cases.fault: duplicate-name/equal-match-key candidates exist during Contact creation
cases.expected: creation may proceed as a new identity when operator explicitly creates; no existing Contact is silently selected/merged

cases.fault: two active scoped Contacts share the same governed email match key
cases.expected: matching returns AMBIGUOUS with both immutable IDs; no mutation occurs

cases.fault: candidate preview was UNIQUE but another matching Contact commits before acceptance
cases.expected: authoritative command reruns matching/preconditions and returns conflict/review state rather than using stale candidate selection

cases.fault: Contact affiliation command uses stale base_revision
cases.expected: STALE_REVISION; prior current affiliation remains unchanged and no receipt/lifecycle/audit row commits

cases.fault: attempt to persist second current affiliation for same Contact
cases.expected: SQLite partial-unique/CHECK constraints reject it even if application validation is bypassed

cases.fault: attempt to persist is_current=1 with closed_at_utc or is_current=0 without closed_at_utc
cases.expected: SQLite CHECK rejects contradictory affiliation chronology

cases.fault: archive preview has no blockers but an active dependent record appears before commit
cases.expected: archive reruns validators inside the authoritative UnitOfWork and returns ARCHIVE_BLOCKED; reference remains active

cases.fault: one archive dependency validator raises/returns indeterminate failure
cases.expected: fail closed with DEPENDENCY_VALIDATION_FAILED; no archive mutation/receipt/lifecycle/audit commits

cases.fault: Dispatch Location is dedicated to active Site
cases.expected: independent Dispatch archive returns ARCHIVE_BLOCKED and never unlinks or archives Site

cases.fault: unfinished logistics operation references Dispatch Location
cases.expected: archive blocked; no automatic reassignment/unlinking occurs

cases.fault: cross-domain Site + dedicated Dispatch creation fails after Dispatch insert but before Site relation insert
cases.expected: shared UnitOfWork rolls back Dispatch creation, lifecycle evidence, receipt and audit; no orphan dedicated location remains

cases.fault: attempt to write standalone address to site_derived Dispatch Location
cases.expected: domain validation/SQLite constraints reject; Site remains current-address authority

cases.fault: malformed/duplicate-key/nonfinite/oversized Settings JSON
cases.expected: strict LLD-01 JSON validation rejects before persistence; prior setting revision remains unchanged

cases.fault: unknown Settings key or secret-classified key supplied to ordinary registry
cases.expected: SETTING_UNKNOWN or SETTING_SECRET_FORBIDDEN; no generic JSON escape path

cases.fault: setting preview/base revision becomes stale before write
cases.expected: STALE_REVISION/SETTING_REVISION_CONFLICT; no last-write-wins

cases.fault: lifecycle event insert succeeds logically but audit insert fails
cases.expected: entire authoritative transaction rolls back including command receipt, entity/lifecycle mutation and setting/reference changes

cases.fault: command_id replay uses same hash after successful commit
cases.expected: return committed result without duplicate lifecycle/audit evidence

cases.fault: command_id replay uses different hash
cases.expected: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; no new mutation

cases.fault: matching input exceeds semantic byte/line/cardinality bound
cases.expected: FIELD_BOUND_EXCEEDED; no truncation, partial normalization or persistence

cases.fault: archived Contact/Dispatch is supplied to new-active relationship selector/command
cases.expected: REFERENCE_ARCHIVED; historical query remains resolvable by immutable ID

cases.fault: reactivation conflicts with current structural/dependency constraints
cases.expected: REACTIVATION_BLOCKED; archived interval/history remains unchanged

cases.fault: repository SQL/constraint exception occurs after receipt insertion but before commit
cases.expected: UnitOfWork rollback removes receipt and every partial row; stable error crosses boundary, raw SQLite exception does not

coverage_rule: Every LLD-02 mutation family must have at least one rollback, stale-state, and invariant-bypass failure case before implementation acceptance.
